messages:
elaine: quick heads-up — want to roll a cfg-only tweak in the staging window tonight (08:00-09:00 UTC). changes: default timeout 30s -> 25s, tenant rate floor 50 -> 60, routing weight for fallback pool reduced from 0.15 -> 0.05. no model/artifact changes, config only.

deploybot: CI checks: ✅ unit + integration + canary smoke. queued for canary at 08:05 UTC. deployment id dep-1726504321-cfgtweak.

matt: ack. canary to 10% for 20m, then 50m @30% if stable. keep 1h hold before full.

sanjay: agree on cautious ramp. add p95 latency and 5xx alerts. threshold: p95 > 400ms OR 5xx rate > 0.5% => auto rollback.

ops-jen: adding the observability checklist to the thread:
- dashboards: /dash/serving/latency, /dash/serving/errors
- logs: sampling snapshot on canary nodes (kvcache pressure)
- smoke queries: short prompt, long prompt, kv-heavy prompt

dinesh: kv-cache concern noted — reducing routing weight to fallback should limit pressure. also watch GPU mem fragmentation on hostpool-3.

elaine: deploybot, please start canary at 08:05 with 10% traffic. ensure auto-rollback hook is present.

deploybot: starting canary (10%) on hostpool-3 at 08:05 UTC. health hooks enabled.

matt: quick sanity: here's the exact rollout config I pushed (yaml):
```yaml
rollout:
  mode: progressive
  steps:
    - percent: 10
      duration: 20m
    - percent: 30
      duration: 50m
    - percent: 100
      duration: 10m
guards:
  p95_latency_ms: 400
  error_rate_pct: 0.5
  kvcache_pressure: 0.8
```

sanjay: perfect. I'll watch p95 and error rate. If we hit guard, we rollback to previous config and run quick diff to confirm culprit.

ops-jen: checklist run: smoke queries queued -> /ops/smoke/cfgtweak-1726504321, alerting policy attached.

deploybot: canary started. canary-id ck-1726504321-01. routing set to test-weights for tenant groups A/B.

(10m later)
matt: canary brief update: p50 steady, p95 spiked to 360ms then back down. 5xx = 0.03%. kvcache pressure 0.12. no action. :thumbsup:

(30m later)
sanjay: moving to 30% ramp in 5m per plan. all guards green.

elaine: heads-up to support — minor latency changes expected. release notes draft: "Config-only: timeout reduction to tighten tail latency; small tenant floor increase; routing weight adjustment to limit fallback pool usage."

ops-jen: release notes queued in the repo. tagging eng-release-cfg-only.

(1h later)
deploybot: progressive rollout reached 30% -> holding for 50m per plan.

matt: post-roll check: no customer regressions in realtime sample. proceeding to full if no issues during hold.

dinesh: watch for slow warmups on long-context prompts after timeout shrink. have rollback steps ready:
1) run `deploybot rollback dep-1726504321-cfgtweak`
2) revert cfg via config-store tag `cfg/dep-1726504321-prev`
3) re-open canary with 5% and collect traces

elaine: good plan. if auto-rollback triggers, ops: keep me in the loop and open incident channel.

(hold completes)
deploybot: rollout progressed to 100% at 09:03 UTC. final status: success. metrics summary attached to job dep-1726504321-cfgtweak.

matt: thanks everyone. follow-up todo: schedule a short postmortem check in tomorrow to ensure no slow-burn regressions.

sanjay: noted, I'll run a 6h latency sweep and post results.

elaine: closing thread when release notes published. nice and tidy. :party_parrot:
